changelog: Explicit code-generation targets: kync --target <triple> selects the machine code for emit-obj, build and run; the same IR cross-compiles to verified x86-64 and AArch64 ELF objects.
Variadic extern declarations (e.g. extern fn printf(format: *const u8, ...) i32) with C default argument promotions; aggregates, slices and bare null in the variadic tail are rejected (E0475).
First-class function values (fn(P) R) and indirect calls: stored in structs, passed to and from C, compared with null, and called through a null-checked indirect call.
Targets without the System V aggregate ABI refuse aggregate boundaries (E0473) instead of lowering the host convention for another machine.
Alpha: no source or ABI stability is promised between releases.
Leaf-based System V classification: nested structs, fixed-array members, pointer leaves and 128-bit integer members cross the C ABI exactly like Clang flattens them.
Aggregate coverage exhausted: a 13,370-shape differential probe finds zero aggregates up to 16 bytes that Kyn rejects but Clang accepts.
packaging/: release-archive tooling with install.sh (Linux, macOS, Git Bash) and install.ps1 / install.bat (Windows) installers.
128-bit integer constants end to end: i128/u128 literals no longer crash the type checker or the backend.
Bool values stored to memory are zero-extended to a full i8, restoring the full-byte definition Clang requires at the C ABI.
Explicit relative-path imports (import "path.kyn" / as alias) with per-source namespaces and private enforcement.
kyn-build hashes transitive Kyn imports into SHA-256 cache stamps.
Slices: open-ended and bounded slicing, const-polymorphic slicing, read-only slice.ptr / slice.len.
Lvalue and mutability hardening; immutable const/let globals.
Runtime-check policy is explicit per profile; all implemented checks are kept in every profile.
Expanded x86_64-linux C ABI aggregate support (SSE/SSEUP, byval/sret) with executable interop fixtures.
Alpha: no source or ABI stability is promised between releases.
Full pipeline: lexer, parser, type checker, static analyzer, typed IR, LLVM backend.
CLI with check, emit-llvm, emit-obj, build and run; safety profiles debug, safe, release, fast.
Subslicing (slice[start..end]), pointer arithmetic, short-circuit boolean operators.
C ABI via extern fn / export fn, including slices as struct { ptr, usize }.
kyn-build with kyn.build files and a hybrid Kyn + C + Zig example.
Diagnostics with stable codes; 900-case deterministic robustness corpus.
First public alpha of the Kyn compiler and toolchain.
kync CLI (check, emit-llvm, emit-obj, build, run) and kyn-build.
Explicit pointers, fixed-size arrays, always-on safety checks (bounds, overflow, division, shifts).
C ABI interoperability through extern fn / export fn.
Tested with Zig 0.17.0 and Clang 23.1.2 on Linux x86-64.
